title: ENS DAO Newsletter #124 - 11/15/2026
headline: Weekly ENS DAO newsletter: two social proposals on the endowment policy and two executable proposals (a roughly 200k USDC working-group funding request and a DNSSEC upgrade) are in discussion, plus the October endowment report.
summary: The newsletter lists two social proposals: IPS Amendment No.1 would let the endowment write fully collateralized options during required ETH/stablecoin rebalances, capped by exposure, tenor and runway safeguards, with Rysk as sole venue pending Board approval; IPS Amendment No.2 would let the ENS Foundation Board amend the endowment policy after a 7-day discussion, replacing MetaGov, while the DAO keeps runway and Section 3 powers. Two executable proposals are listed: funding the Meta-Governance Working Group through Term 7 with about 200k USDC from wallet.ensdao.eth, and upgrading the DNSSEC oracle, registrar and resolver after the 2026 root KSK rollover, adding KSK-2024 and DAO-updatable trust anchors. Reported figures: the October endowment report shows AUM at $90.71M versus $98.70M, ETH allocation down from 59.9% to 45.5%, and $289,177 of monthly yield. The ENS Foundation Board approved a restated 2026 operating budget of $423,028.40 (previously $382,641.04). ENS Labs reported about 29k names migrated to ENSv2. MetaGov logged four October payments totalling roughly $86.7k in USD terms. No temp checks, ENSIPs or commits this week. Open points: outcome of the pending votes and Board approval of the options venue.
